book.name: 1 THESSALONIANS
book.title: Id ash d Paul Wehpeg Oꞌohana am ha Wui g Thessalonica t Am Wohochuddam

content: Matsh has i e juh g Paul amai Thessalonica t am
Am am wa s-mahch ahpim t-wehm wohochuddam mat s-ap haꞌichu am hab e juh heg hekaj matt am dada am ahgachugch g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga.

Am ach wa em-ahgid mat haꞌi t-shoꞌigch amai Philippi kihhim t am matt eda koi am hu dada em-wui. T wabshaba g Jiosh ab i t-mah g gewkdag. Kutt am wabsh s-chechojim ahgachug g s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj em-wui, chum as muꞌi ab t-wui gegok.
Haꞌichu t-chegitoidag o am wabsh si s-apꞌe. Pi ach em-iattogid ch wabshaba wabsh s-chechojim ahg g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga mamt ab wui wo i e dagito.

Jiosh at t-aꞌappem k am i t-chuhcha matt wo i ahgahi g s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj. Kuch heg hab waꞌi junihim mo haschu d tatchuij ch pi wabsh g hemajkam ha-tatchui hab junimk. Jiosh o am t-mamche mach haschu ahgch hab haꞌichu junihim.
Am am wa s-mahch mach pi wabsh em-hehosimhun ch pi em-iattogid machs wo haꞌichu em-wohppoꞌi. Jiosh o s-mahch mo d wohokam ihda.
Pi ach hekid am hu t-gahgid mas g oꞌodham ab wo ge has t-elidad ch ab wo t-hehgchulidad.

Bo hi wa chum mahs mamt ab wo si has t-elidad ch haꞌichukaj wo i t-wehmtad ahchim mach d Jesus chuhchai. Kuch wabshaba pi am hu t-gahgid ihda nach pi si s-hemajim ab em-neid hab masma mat g ha-jeꞌe ab wo ha neidad g e-aꞌaliga.
Si ach pihk t-elid ab em-wui ch hekaj am wabsh i t-dagitokch em-wehhejed mach em-ahgidahim g s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj g Jiosh, chum achs hems heg hekaj wo t-koꞌij.
Am amtp hu waꞌi s-chegito mach si chikpan wabsh i siꞌalim amjed ch mehk s-chuhugam k ed matt pi haꞌichukaj wo em-kudu.
Si ach wa s-ap ab em-neid ch pi hekid hab wua g pi apꞌekam ab hema i em-wui. Jiosh o s-mahch ihda. Kum ahpim hab waꞌap s-mahch.

Jiosh o ab i em-waid mamt am wo apꞌedagk kihdaj ed ch ab wehmaj wo uꞌukchid g ab has elidadag. Kum s-mahch mach am i em-gewkemhun wepo masma mo g ha-ohg ch ab s-ap i em-neneokid ch i em-chehani mamt am hab wo masmak mam d Jiosh aꞌaliga.

Heg ach waꞌi ahgachug Jiosh haꞌichu ahga ch pi g hemajkam haꞌichu ha-ahga. Kumt hab waꞌi masma hab elid k hekaj ab i s-wohoch. Jiosh o am i chikpan em-shahgid ch am wohokamchud mo d haꞌichu ahgaj. Kuch hekaj chum hekid ab si hoꞌigeꞌelid.

Am am ha oidch hab e wua hegam e-wehm wohochuddam mo am aꞌai kih Judea ch ed. Ha-wehm oꞌodham o ha shoꞌigchud. K hegam wabsh s-ap ab nakog. Kum ahpim hab waꞌap wabsh s-ap ab nakog mo g em-wehm oꞌodham em-shoꞌigchud.

Do hegam ni-wehm oꞌodham mat wa mua g t-kownalig Jesus. Kush d t-shohshon mat wa ha kokda g Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam. K hegam ni-wehm oꞌodham t-shoꞌigchud ch gm hu i t-wuwhas ahchim mach am ahgachug g s-kehg haꞌichu ahgaj g Jiosh. K g Jiosh pi hohhoꞌid mo has e wua. Chum o hems ab wehs ha wui gegok g hemajkam

chum t-shohbidch ahchim mach ha ahgid g goꞌol hemajkam hegai mat hekaj wo e doꞌibia. T id ab wabsh baꞌich i geꞌedaj g pi ap ha-chuꞌijig. Kut heg gam hu ai mat ab ha wui wo jiwia g wehs s-koꞌok ha-namkidadag.
Mash g Paul am ep s-ha chehgimelimk
Pi att shaꞌi pi em-chegito matt hekid am i t-gawulkai ab em-amjed. Chum ach s-em neidamk
ch am ha hekaj chum si i t-nako matt am uhpam wo hihi em-wui. Ahni Paul ant muꞌikko am chum uhpam s-himim. T am ni-kuh g jijawul ha-geꞌejig Satan.
M eda d ahpim mach am si em-hiwig ch em-hekaj wo si s-hehgigk ch ab wo si hoꞌigeꞌel g t-kownalig Jesus mat hekid ep wo jiwia.
